result.title: Guided Group Featurizers (GGF): Improving Block-Sparse Featurizers with Object-Guided Learning
result.summary: Block-sparse featurizers (BSFs) use groups of learned directions to capture the multidimensional structure of visual concepts. However, grouping alone does not ensure that information about a concept is consolidated within a single group. We introduce Guided Group Featurizers (GGF), a novel object-guided extension that uses object annotations for initialization and training while preserving the BSF architecture. We assess whether each group's strongest response regions share an object type, part or material across images. Blinded reviews give GGF groups an average semantic coherence score of $94.1\pm0.9$%, versus $83.0\pm1.9$% for SLiCS and $65.3\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF. GGF's consolidation advantage extends to unguided categories: one selected group per category covers $65.6\pm2.4$% of target-containing crops, versus $58.2\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF, at approximately 5% false-positive rates for both. Across COCO and VOC, GGF also improves single-group object Capture and localization over Vanilla BSFs, SLiCS and Concept-SAE. Its groups produce more focused and reproducible object responses while supporting recognition and retaining associations under rotation, scale and brightness changes. GGF also uses fewer learned parameters than Concept-SAE and shorter recorded VOC training loops than both supervised alternatives. These findings support object guidance for organizing more interpretable BSF groups and show that response concentration extends to categories excluded from guidance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Guided Group Featurizers（GGF），在保留 block-sparse featurizer 架构的前提下用物体标注引导初始化与训练，使每个稀疏方向组的强响应区域对应同一物体、部件或材料，并用盲评语义一致性、单组覆盖率与定位等指标评估响应集中度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「概念信息是否被归并进单一稀疏组」的度量与组内响应集中性分析，可能可供核查 LVR 内部视觉证据是否保留、是否坍缩到少数子空间；但该工作纯属视觉特征可解释性，无推理与状态更新环节，映射关系需核查。
